analysis: Post hoc attribution sensitivity using already published repository counts; no reassignment or hypothesis test
unit: patient by histology, preserving repeated patients across histologies
assumptions: Observed IL1B counts attributable to their captured cells
Unassigned counts may range from none to all macrophage-derived
calculation: M = assigned macrophage IL1B / all observed IL1B; U = unassigned IL1B / all observed IL1B; conditional bounds [M,M+U]; majority crossover alpha=(0.5-M)/U
interpretation: Conditional observed-RNA accounting; not confidence intervals, secreted protein, ambient correction, or biological identity discovery
no_fits: No source/recipient fit unless independent units and comparable compartments pass their existing gates
